key_differences_from_mt940_camt053.details: MT942 has no field 60F/62F (opening/closing booked balances). MT940 is end-of-day final statement, MT942 is intraday interim report.
MT942 has fields 90C (total credit entries) and 90D (total debit entries) for transaction summary. MT940 does not have these summary fields.
MT942 uses field 34F (floor limit indicator) for available balance. MT940 uses field 64 (closing available balance).
MT942 has field 13D (date/time indication) showing when report was generated. MT940 has no timestamp field, only dates in balance fields.
MT942 reports are generated during the day (interim), MT940 is end-of-day (final). This affects balance type codes: FWAV vs OPBD/CLBD/ITAV.

transaction_summary.notes: Summary totals in fields 90C and 90D. Actual entries shown are subset (2 of 13 total transactions).

round_trip_notes: MT->MX->MT preserves all interim report data including summary totals. MX->MT->MX loses the from/to datetime range detail (only report creation time preserved in MT). Field 13D provides timestamp which MT940 lacks.

validation_notes.mt_validation: Valid MT942 interim report. Field 13D provides timestamp. Fields 90C/90D provide transaction summaries. Field 34F shows available balance. Actual entry count (2) is less than summary totals (13 total), which is normal for filtered/large reports.
validation_notes.mx_validation: Valid camt.052 interim account report. TxsSummry provides detailed transaction summaries. FrToDt shows reporting period. Balance type FWAV indicates forward available (interim).
